posts.title: And now for some other news…
posts.description: Just a short note to say that Friday was my last day at Lucidworks (again). From Monday, I’m going to be the new Chief Data Scientist at Hermetiq , where I will be doing exciting things with search and whatnot alongside Bazel build systems. Fancier job title, but even harder to explain what I actually do!

posts.title: Saturday Night Plumbing

posts.description: Okay, technically, it’s Maeryn’s fourth Hallowe’en, but only the second that she’s really understood, and the second where she has actively gone trick or treating.
